component.name: OpenLW
component.summary: Livewire and AES67 audio on the computer
Audio Livewire et AES67 sur l’ordinateur

description.p: OpenLW connects the computer to a Livewire®- or AES67-compatible audio network. Applications see two PipeWire devices: “OpenLW Out” transmits to the network, “OpenLW In” receives the chosen channels.

ul.li: Discovery of the sources advertised on the network, and an input routing grid
Outputs transmitted on the Livewire channels of your choice, in Standard, AES67 and Livestream formats
Preview of a source on the computer's audio output
systemd user service, with no privileges or kernel module

description.p: Livewire is a trademark of TLS Corp. OpenLW is not affiliated with TLS Corp.
First Linux release: PipeWire nodes and GTK app.
